description: This file defines the SDKBuildProject class used for managing SDK build processes, including downloading archives, configuring, installing, logging, and executing shell commands within a build environment.

classes.name: SDKBuildProject
classes.description: A class that extends BuildProject to handle SDK build operations such as downloading, configuring, installing, and executing commands in a build environment.

methods.name: __init__(self, testpath, sdkenv, uri, testlogdir, builddatetime, foldername=None, dl_dir=None)
methods.description: Initializes the SDKBuildProject with paths, environment, and build information, creating necessary directories and setting up variables.

methods.name: download_archive(self)
methods.description: Downloads and extracts the build archive, updating target directory.

methods.name: run_configure(self, configure_args='', extra_cmds='')
methods.description: Runs the configuration step with specified arguments.

methods.name: run_install(self, install_args='')
methods.description: Runs the install step with specified arguments.

methods.name: log(self, msg)
methods.description: Appends a message to the log file.

methods.name: _run(self, cmd)
methods.description: Executes a shell command in the build environment, logging the command and handling errors.
